script_sections.title: Opening
script_sections.content:
Good evening, residents, guests, and the people who only come downstairs for the AGM and the annual day.

Welcome to [SOCIETY NAME]'s annual function. This is our once-a-year reminder that we share more than a gate code: we share water tanks, festivals, and very strong opinions about the lift.

Tonight's plan is simple. A short welcome, a look at the year that was, performances you signed up for, a few games so the children don't annex the stage, and a vote of thanks before dinner — I have been warned not to delay dinner.

I am [HOST NAME], your host. If I mispronounce a name, correct me; if I mispronounce the society name, we have bigger problems.

script_sections.title: Year in Review (light)
script_sections.content:
A 90-second version of the year, without minutes of the meeting:
- We kept the lights on, the tanks reasonably full, and the group chat reasonably on fire.
- Thank you to the committee members who actually attended the boring meetings so the rest of us could attend the interesting ones.
- If we completed a repair, name it. If we didn't, skip it — this is a function, not a FIR.

Please welcome [SECRETARY / CHAIR] for a two-minute note. Two. I have a stopwatch and no shame.

script_sections.title: Segment Transitions
script_sections.content:
INTO CULTURALS: Official remarks are over. Unofficial talent begins. I'll read the running order. Performers, please be ready two acts before yours. The wings of this 'stage' are a garden path — don't get lost in a conversation with the uncle who 'just had one question'.

INTO GAMES: Winners of the cultural round get applause. Winners of the games get bragging rights in the lift tomorrow.

INTO DINNER: When you hear the vote of thanks, it is not a suggestion. It is a dinner bell in slow motion.

script_sections.title: Closing / Vote of Thanks
script_sections.content:
Thank you to the organising team, the volunteers, the security and housekeeping staff who stayed late, and every family that rehearsed in a 2BHK without a noise complaint becoming a legal notice.

Thank you to our performers and to the residents who clapped even for the acts that were... brave.

Please proceed to dinner. Take a plate, leave a little for the last row, and if you have feedback, there is a committee — but maybe tomorrow.

Good night, and see you at the next festival, AGM, or water-tanker emergency, whichever comes first.

songs.title: Society anthem / welcome instrumental
songs.note: Soft instrumental while people find seats. Keep lyrics-free so speeches can start over it.

songs.title: Classic Bollywood medley
songs.note: Crowd-pleaser for mixed ages; put in the middle of the cultural block.

songs.title: Kids' group song
songs.note: Schedule early. Tired children are a risk to the sound system.

songs.title: Senior residents' favourite
songs.note: Ask the committee which film song the 60+ crowd actually wants. Don't guess.

activities.title: Find Your Wing
activities.description: Call out a wing or building letter. That group stands and must complete a 10-second cheer. Instant mixing, instant noise, good photos.

activities.title: Guess the Resident
activities.description: Host reads a fun fact submitted on the public form (no names). Audience guesses who it is. Use only facts people agreed to share.

activities.title: Musical Chairs — Society Edition
activities.description: Classic game. Music: old Hindi film songs. Last person sitting names one thing they like about living here. Then they are out. Kind, not brutal.

activities.title: One-Minute Talent
activities.description: Open mic, 60 seconds, no karaoke machine required: joke, shloka, whistle, magic trick. Host is the timer. Cuts are merciful and public.

activities.title: Committee vs Residents Quiz
activities.description: Five light questions: year the society was registered, colour of the old gate, name of the watchman who retired. No actual politics. Prize: first in the dinner line.
